text: On December 23, 2019, an Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment application was submitted to amend the Sheppard East Subway Corridor Secondary Plan and the former City of North York Zoning By-law No. 7652 and Zoning By-law 1094-2002, as amended by Zoning By-law 961-2009, for the property at 1181 Sheppard Avenue East. The proposal sought to permit a mixed-use development comprised of a 22-storey tower (89.15 metres) with 39,033 square metres of office space, and a 33-storey residential tower (105.7 metres) with 452 residential units connected by a 5-storey (19 metre) podium. On November 19, 2021, the Applicant appealed the application to the Ontario Land Tribunal ("OLT") due to Council not making a decision within the 120-day time frame in the Planning Act.
